hole_sweep.decision: Keep current shelf prototype; hole cases demonstrate lower gas circulation, not superior cell exposure. No new CAD/print option is released.
hole_sweep.scope: Fixed six holes; pitch is spacing, not total hole-count density. Q normalized1mL/min. Hole/gap staircase sensitivity remains.

conditions.method: Cell-centered conservative FV; backward Euler, first-order upwind advection, central diffusion. Face-flux projection enforces discrete incompressibility.
conditions.boundary: C=1 at upstream inlet terminal; zero diffusive outlet flux; convective outlet; impermeable solid AND liquid boundaries; initially C=0 throughout gas.
conditions.scope: Gas only. No odor identity, membrane, liquid, adsorption, reaction, cells, filters, external tubing. D is a sensitivity assumption, not a measured target-VOC coefficient.

gas_transport.scope: Gas-only species delivery; no liquid uptake or cell arrival. Local low Pe permits diffusion even when velocity markers barely move.

configuration.scope: Prespecified bounded gas-side operation comparison for unchanged selected-shelf STL; no biological safety or activation target.

targets.status: Provisional engineering comparison targets declared before new results; not user-confirmed and not biological injury thresholds.

configuration.selection_rule: Select the smallest sampled Q satisfying all declared constraints across four wells and all three assumed Dgas values. If no Q qualifies, return no selection. Publish nondominated worst-case gas t90 versus gas P95 speed without weighted scores. Dgas is an uncertain material property, not an adjustable operating knob.
configuration.model: Gas-only conservative FV with prescribed steady Stokes-scaled saved velocity, impermeable liquid surface. No membrane or liquid uptake.
configuration.validation_plan: Q5/D10 dx0.3 and dt0.125 checks; Q0.25/D10 dt0.5 check; direct near5mLmin velocity solve on dx0.3/tau0.55 compared against existing near1mLmin solution, plus scalar on the direct field.

adaptive_refinement.declared_after: Stage-1 results bracket the provisional 60-s target: Q2 gives about 74–75 s while Q5 gives about 30–32 s.
adaptive_refinement.reason: Resolve the wide flow bracket before recommending its highest endpoint. Preserve all original cases and selection targets; do not move thresholds.
adaptive_refinement.selection_rule: Combine stages and select the smallest actually simulated Q satisfying the original worst-well/worst-D target and engineering caps. Do not interpolate an untested optimum.
adaptive_refinement.classification: Adaptive numerical parameter refinement, not an independent preregistered validation experiment.

operation_extension.decision_status: Conditional operating candidate; provisional targets, numerical checks only, no physical or biological validation.

direct_flow_check.scope: Same grid and relaxation parameter comparison, flow amplitude differs. Finite-inertia and boundary effects remain; not a continuum grid-independence proof.

operation_extension.scope: Conditional lowest-flow choice from seven sampled Q levels for fixed geometry, robust only over the three assumed gas diffusivities. Gas concentration, not cell exposure or safety. No weighted objective or global optimum is claimed.
